description: Marking a known assignment finished retains it in the full list with finished true; repeated completion is harmless and unknown IDs cannot alter state.
Active list and remaining count exclude finished assignments while preserving the order and content of unfinished assignments.
Explicit save and load into a fresh tracker preserve finished status and unfinished status.
Existing saved assignments without a finished field load as unfinished; title validation, record isolation, ordering, and unique IDs still work.
